task: Write a Python function that extracts the AWS region from an S3 bucket URL. The function should handle URLs in the format 's3://bucket-name' and 's3.region.amazonaws.com/bucket-name'. Return the region or 'us-east-1' if not specified.
Create a JSON object representing an AWS IAM policy that allows a user to read objects from a specific S3 bucket named 'my-data-bucket'. Include the appropriate Action, Resource, and Effect fields.
Write a regular expression that validates an AWS EC2 security group ID. The ID format should start with 'sg-' followed by 8 or 17 hexadecimal characters.
